proposed_comments.title: Control the timer in the root-page loading test

confidence.rationale: Pinned source uses a real timer and exact event counts. A controlled-time source harness observed an extra Periodic event; the actual test-project build failed in AdaptiveCards dependencies, so the focused tests did not run. Exposure depends on test-host uptime.

proposed_comments.body:
### Control the timer in the root-page loading test

**Severity:** `low`

This constructor defaults to `TimeProvider.System`. The first periodic heartbeat is aligned to the next 30-minute process-uptime boundary, so a test host near that boundary can append `Periodic` while this test asserts exact event counts of one and two. This creates a timing-dependent test failure rather than a failure in phase loading.

Please inject a controlled `TimeProvider` with a manually fired timer. Extract the existing private `TestTimeProvider` from `HeartbeatTelemetryTests` into a shared test utility, or provide an equivalent test-local provider.

**Verification:** use fake uptime immediately before a 30-minute boundary and confirm that this test records only the two phase events unless the timer is explicitly fired. Keep periodic callbacks covered separately by `HeartbeatTelemetryTests`.
